scope: Source-incarnation controller with real worker threads and synthetic empty libraries
checks: Unchanged source observation preserves active worker
Changed mount identity joins old worker before endpoint close/reopen
Reconnect uses a fresh generation and random nonce
Retiring one source preserves the neighbor
Endpoint open failure does not spin or affect neighbor
Final drain releases endpoint sockets after join
limitations: Not yet connected to native discovery/eject or endpoint allocator
Two empty synthetic libraries; no multi-stick browse/playback acceptance
Controller drain is not native unmount or external cache acceptance
